li.label: under strain
li.description: It's been one hard thing after another lately, and it's catching up with me.

li.label: worn down
li.description: I'm tired in a way a night's sleep doesn't fix. Everything takes more out of me than it should.

li.label: at the end of my rope
li.description: I snap at people over nothing and can't remember why after. One more thing could tip me over.

li.label: let it all out
li.description: I put my work down and went off on my own until it had all come out. My shoulders have finally come down.

li.label: idle days
li.description: Everyone's lying around while the work piles up. I can't stand it.

li.label: slow days
li.description: Short days and long evenings. I'd rather be doing something.

li.label: a few easy days
li.description: Evenings that go on and no early start. I'm sleeping better already.

li.label: a real rest
li.description: No early mornings, nobody shouting for help with the stone. I lay in until I got bored of lying in.
